pages.text: Rumors speak of certain lords of the $(l)crypts$() who forged $(l)some kind of weapon$(). Such a weapon could greatly increase the souls you harvest from creatures, and erupt with a mighty soul-shaking burst when souls are plentiful. Yet, just as those lords failed to complete the necromancy upon themselves, these weapons never reached their full potential.

It is said that when you enter the crypts bearing a $(l)Bad Omen$() and awaken these lords, they become far more powerful and wrathful. Defeating these $(l)wrathful lords$() seems to be the only way to obtain such a weapon, though you still suspect it may yet be a counterfeit.
